metadata.question: Were chlorophyll concertrations at 100km radius around (-41.729403, -125.410394) up during November 2019 to February 2020 in comparison to the same time the prior year?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: MODIS Ocean Color data (chlorophyll concentration) - Location: 100km radius around (-41.729403, -125.410394) - this is in the Pacific Ocean - Time periods: * Current: November 2019 to February 2020 * Prior: November 2018 to February 2019 - Band: 'chlor_a' for chlorophyll concentration 2. Masking strategy: - MODIS Ocean Color data has quality flags, but for simplicity I'll just use valid pixel ranges - Chlorophyll values should be positive, so mask negative/zero values 3. Logic: - Get mean chlorophyll for both periods - Compare if 2019-2020 period has higher concentration than 2018-2019 - Check for empty collections, no valid pixels, or calculation failures I'll use MODIS Aqua Ocean Color data which has good chlorophyll data. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const point = ee.Geometry.Point([-125.410394, -41.729403]); const region = point.buffer(100000); // 100km radius // Time periods const currentStart = '2019-11-01'; const currentEnd = '2020-02-29'; const priorStart = '2018-11-01'; const priorEnd = '2019-02-28'; // 2. Data Acquisition function getChlorophyllData(startDate, endDate) { return ee.ImageCollection('NASA/OCEANDATA/MODIS-Aqua/L3SMI') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(region) .select('chlor_a'); } const currentCollection = getChlorophyllData(currentStart, currentEnd); const priorCollection = getChlorophyllData(priorStart, priorEnd); // Check collection sizes const currentSize = currentCollection.size().getInfo(); const priorSize = priorCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Current period (${currentStart} to ${currentEnd}): ${currentSize} images`); console.log(`Prior period (${priorStart} to ${priorEnd}): ${priorSize} images`); if (currentSize === 0 || priorSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Create mean composites and mask invalid values function processCollection(collection) { const meanImg = collection.mean(); // Mask negative/zero values (chlorophyll should be positive) const masked = meanImg.updateMask(meanImg.gt(0)); return masked; } const currentMean = processCollection(currentCollection); const priorMean = processCollection(priorCollection); // 4. Calculate statistics and check valid pixels function getStats(image, periodName) { const stats = image.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const meanVal = stats.get('chlor_a').getInfo(); const count = stats.get('chlor_a_count').getInfo(); console.log(`${periodName}: Mean=${meanVal ? meanVal.toFixed(4) : 'null'}, ValidPixels=${count}`); return {mean: meanVal, count: count}; } const currentStats = getStats(currentMean, 'Current'); const priorStats = getStats(priorMean, 'Prior'); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (currentStats.count === 0 || priorStats.count === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } if (currentStats.mean === null || priorStats.mean === null || isNaN(currentStats.mean) || isNaN(priorStats.mean)) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Check if current period has higher chlorophyll const currentHigher = currentStats.mean > priorStats.mean; const diffPercent = ((currentStats.mean - priorStats.mean) / priorStats.mean * 100).toFixed(1); console.log(`Change: ${diffPercent}% (${currentHigher ? 'increase' : 'decrease'})`); if (currentHigher) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
